description: Hand labels for the malformed question stems the benchmark generator produces and rejects. `malformed` means the request does not name a subject -- it is a truncated fragment, a deictic reference with no referent, or a verb phrase. `well_formed` means it does name a subject, even when that subject is awkward, an acronym, hyphenated, a gerund noun, or has a typo. The distinction is not the generator's: the generator rejects a subject for any of eight reasons, six of which are cosmetic, and most of the stems it rejects are still perfectly good questions.
provenance: Labelled by hand by the project author, against the stems harvested from the six-category corpus. The labels and the rule under test share an author, so the rates they produce are an author-label measurement, not an independent annotation. The labels are published so that a reader can disagree with any of them in the open, and so that a change to the harvest shows up as unlabelled stems rather than as a silent change in the denominator.
